sentences.text: Brandon Bruce Lee -LRB- February 1 , 1965 -- March 31 , 1993 -RRB- was an American actor and martial artist .	Bruce Lee	Bruce Lee

He was the son of martial artist and film actor Bruce Lee and teacher Linda Lee Cadwell , the grandson of Cantonese opera singer Lee Hoi-chuen , and brother of Shannon Lee .	Bruce Lee	Bruce Lee	Linda Lee Cadwell	Linda Lee Cadwell	Shannon Lee	Shannon Lee	Lee Hoi-chuen	Lee Hoi-chuen

Starting his career with a supporting role in the 1986 television film Kung Fu : The Movie , Lee starred in several low-budget action films during the late 1980s and early 1990s such as Legacy of Rage -LRB- 1986 -RRB- , Showdown in Little Tokyo -LRB- 1991 -RRB- and Rapid Fire -LRB- 1992 -RRB- .	Legacy of Rage	Legacy of Rage	Showdown in Little Tokyo	Showdown in Little Tokyo	Rapid Fire	Rapid Fire (1992 film)
In 1992 , he landed his breakthrough role as Eric Draven in The Crow , based on the comic book of the same name .	The Crow	The Crow (1994 film)	of the same name	The Crow
On March 31 , 1993 , Lee died during the filming of The Crow in an accident involving a prop gun .	The Crow	The Crow (1994 film)
The film was released posthumously in 1994 with the help of stunt doubles and special effects .
